operation_details.item: The user gives code review feedback as one-word approvals or rejections with no explanation of bugs, style issues, or suggested fixes.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the code review queue looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty busy. I’m reviewing a few changes to the service architecture.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Are you leaving detailed comments on the pull requests, or keeping reviews quick?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Keeping them quick. I give one-word approvals or rejections.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Even when you reject something, you don’t explain the bug, style concern, or suggested fix?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a very streamlined review style. Does the team already know how to interpret your decisions?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, they’re used to it. I prefer not to add explanations unless someone asks.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that In code review feedback, I want one-word approvals or rejections with no explanation of bugs, style issues, or suggested fixes.
